headline: Study estimates Faria Lima ground floors could generate R$100 million annual rent
summary: A real estate study by Where and Space Hunters mapped 15,000 square meters of vacant ground-floor space across São Paulo's Faria Lima avenue, estimating potential annual rental income of R$100 million.
why: Avenida Faria Lima is São Paulo's primary financial district and corporate commercial real estate hub.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Commercial real estate monetization boosts municipal property yields in financial hubs.
